description: Adds named contacts to a started campaign's audience, as the roster's add does: each is checked against the campaign's safety rules and the answer names who was added, who was skipped and why. Only an active audience-filter campaign enrolls specific rows. A step due today is drafted, never sent: use send_campaign_messages after your person confirms to send. confirmOverCap: true only when your person accepts going over today's cap (the answer says over_daily_cap with the numbers otherwise). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat enrolls nobody twice.

clientId.description: One contact to enroll instead of clientIds.

confirmOverCap.description: true only when your person accepts going over today's cap.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: enroll_campaign_recipients
title: Enroll named contacts into a campaign
